description: An HTML file implementing the user interface for a database visualization dashboard, including styles and client-side scripting for fetching and displaying database names, tables, and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching data from the API.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the table list for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a specific database from the API.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data of a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML to display table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell values, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expansion of cell content to show full data.
